header.title: Context Menu
header.description: Action menu that opens on right-click over an element, instead of the browser menu. On touch screens it opens with a press and hold, and from the keyboard with Shift+F10 or the menu key. Use it for quick actions on something specific: a file, a row or a card. Since it isn't visible at a glance, don't put actions that only exist here: offer them in a button or a Dropdown Menu too.

demo.hint: Right-click here, or press and hold on a touch screen.

playground.title: Playground
playground.description: Adjust the props and right-click the surface to see the result. With the surface focused you can also use Shift+F10.

base.title: Basic usage
base.description: Wrap the element with `ContextMenu` and pass the options in `items`. The menu appears where you clicked, stays inside the element's area and closes when you pick, press Escape, click outside or move the pointer out of the area. `onAction` receives the chosen `id`. Items are the same as in Dropdown Menu: `icon`, `shortcut`, `href` and separators.

texts.title: Invoice draft
texts.hint: Right-click to edit, share or delete.

card.title: On a card
card.description: You can wrap any block, like a `Card`. The browser menu is replaced only on that element; everywhere else on the page it works as usual. `className` goes to the wrapper around the element.

texts.title: Warehouse inventory
texts.subtitle: Updated 2 hours ago
texts.body: Stock, owners and pending tasks. Right-click the card to see the document actions.

disabledDanger.title: Disabled and danger
disabledDanger.description: `disabled` keeps the item visible but dimmed, and the keyboard skips it. `description` adds a help line. `danger` paints the item red for destructive actions; it's best to separate it from the rest.

texts.title: Locked project
texts.hint: Archive is disabled and delete is destructive.

sizes.title: Sizes
sizes.description: `size` changes item padding and text: `sm`, `md` (default) or `lg`. Try each surface separately.

selection.title: Checkboxes and options
selection.description: `type: "checkbox"` adds an option that toggles on and off, and `type: "radio-group"` a group of exclusive options. The menu stays open after changing them. `type: "label"` adds a section heading.

submenu.title: Submenu
submenu.description: `type: "submenu"` groups options in a second level. It opens on hover or with Arrow Right, and closes with Arrow Left or Escape. Since the menu closes when leaving the area, the submenu has to stay inside the element: use it on wide surfaces.

texts.title: Team member
texts.hint: Right-click to see the profile or share.

disabledTarget.title: Disabled element
disabledTarget.description: With `isDisabled` the custom menu doesn't open and right-click shows the regular browser menu. The element stops being focusable and gets `aria-disabled`.

multiple.title: Multiple elements
multiple.description: Each element can have its own menu with different actions. Opening another one closes the previous. If the pointer leaves the element the menu closes, even if the panel sits on top of a neighbor.

folder.title: Invoices
folder.hint: Open, create a file or share.

list.title: On list rows
list.description: On small elements, like list rows, the menu is taller than the row and partly sits outside it. With `closeOnLeave={false}` it doesn't close when you move the pointer to the panel; it closes when you pick, press Escape or click outside. While open, the row has `aria-expanded="true"`, which you can use to highlight it.

header.title: Context Menu API
header.description: API reference for the ContextMenu React component: props, CSS classes, tokens and exported types.

demos.title: Demos
demos.description: For examples and usage details, visit the component demos page.

import.title: Import
import.description: You can import it from the main entry or from its subpath.

inheritance.title: Inheritance
inheritance.body: Accepts the HTML attributes of a <div> (HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>), except children and onChange, and passes them to the wrapper around the element, not the panel. The same goes for className. For the panel use classNames.menu. classNames accepts root, target (both go to the wrapper), menu, item, label and separator.

a11y.title: Accessibility
a11y.target: The wrapper is focusable (tabIndex=0) and has aria-haspopup="menu", aria-expanded and aria-controls.
a11y.open: It opens on right-click, with Shift+F10 or the menu key when the element has focus, and with a press and hold on touch screens.
a11y.menu: The panel has role="menu" with menuLabel as aria-label, and items have the same roles as in Dropdown Menu.
a11y.keyboard: Arrows move through items, Home and End jump to the ends, Enter or Space pick, Escape closes and typing a letter jumps to the item that starts with it.
a11y.focus: When opened with mouse or keyboard, focus moves to the panel; when closing with Escape or picking, it returns to the element. Tab closes the menu.
a11y.leave: With closeOnLeave (default) the menu closes when the pointer leaves the element's area.
a11y.touch: Press and hold opens the menu after 500 ms (longPressMs). If the finger moves more than 10 px, it cancels. On touch, focus doesn't move to the panel, to avoid opening the virtual keyboard.
a11y.labels: menuLabel is in English by default ("Actions"). Pass it translated. Since the menu isn't visible, offer the same actions in a visible control too.

cssClasses.title: CSS classes
cssClasses.description: Context Menu uses the same panel as Dropdown Menu, so it shares its classes. The panel renders in `document.body`, outside the element, so selectors that depend on it won't reach it.

rules.root: Wrapper around the element. Receives `className`, `classNames.root` and `classNames.target`. Shows the focus ring.
rules.ready: Applied once the panel is positioned. Before that it stays invisible.
rules.active: Active item, hovered or chosen with the keyboard.
rules.labelText: Item text. Truncated with an ellipsis.

cssVariables.title: CSS variables
cssVariables.description: Context Menu has no variables of its own: it uses gem-system tokens directly. To change colors on a single menu, redefine those tokens in a class and pass it in `classNames.menu`.

tokens.title: Tokens
tokens.description: gem-system tokens used by Context Menu.

items.--gem-color-fg-muted: Descriptions, shortcuts, section headings and arrows.

types.title: Exported types
types.description: Available from @gem-org/gem-system to type your own wrappers. Item types are aliases of the Dropdown Menu ones.

props.title: Props
props.description: It also accepts the HTML attributes of the wrapper.

items.items: Menu entries: actions, separators, headings, checkboxes, options and submenus.
items.children: Element that opens the menu on right-click.
items.isDisabled: Doesn't open the custom menu and leaves the browser one.
items.closeOnLeave: Closes the menu when the pointer leaves the element's area.
items.longPressMs: Milliseconds to press and hold on touch to open it. `0` or `false` turns it off.
items.open: Whether the menu is open. Controlled mode.
items.defaultOpen: Whether it starts open. Uncontrolled mode.
items.onOpenChange: Called when opening or closing. Receives the new state.
items.onAction: Called when an action is chosen. Receives its `id`.
items.onCheckedChange: Called when a checkbox changes. Receives the `id` and the new value.
items.onRadioChange: Called when an option is chosen. Receives the group `id` and the option `id`.

items.title: Item types
items.description: `ContextMenuItem` is the same type as `DropdownMenuItem`: actions, checkboxes, option groups, submenus, separators and headings, with the same props.
items.link: See each item's props in the Dropdown Menu API
